---
name: New mechanic
about: Something documents cannot express today
labels: enhancement
---

**What a document cannot express**
The surface or behaviour, with the document you would like to write.

**Why the existing mechanics do not reach it**
What you tried: expressions, actions, `$repeat`, lifecycle, watch, host
functions. A mechanic enters the contract only when a document could not
express something without it.

**What it would cost**
Which specs change, what the vectors would pin, and what every engine would
have to implement. Mechanics land in all three engines together.
